description: HyperMemory plugin — recall on prompt submit, background persistence on stop

hooks.command: echo 'Apply the HyperMemory skill. Classify this prompt as lightweight only when, after trimming whitespace and punctuation, it is at most 80 characters and consists solely of a greeting or acknowledgement: hey, hello, hi, howdy, thanks, thank you, okay, ok, or got it. For lightweight prompts, skip hm_get_overview and hm_recall on the main agent. Otherwise call hm_get_overview if needed, then hm_recall before substantive work. Short tasks, questions, entities, file paths, code, numbers, and decisions are substantive.'

echo 'Dispatch exactly one fresh hypermemory:memory-writer background agent with a bounded turn summary. Once the Agent tool call succeeds, stop immediately. Do not wait for, poll, inspect, message, or read the writer. The writer handles recall, graph writes, one timeline entry, and one token report according to the HyperMemory skill.'
